title: What happened to the egg-shaped craft Barber retrieved

plain: An egg-shaped craft that was lifted out of a site is said to have been taken to a secure facility, where it was either destroyed, hidden or buried. A former helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he retrieved it with his own helicopter, tells Michels this, adding that whoever holds it has so many such craft now that this one was not interesting to them.
